gen-dafont-neon-gf-georama: Glowing letters in Neon hold one ballpoint-plain line from end to end. Georama, an approachable sans with a c like a bracelet pulled apart, gives that glow somewhere gentle to land beneath it.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-gidole: Gidole reads clean, its terminals parted like open scissor blades. Neon's glowing, stamped-metal lowercase takes the loud role on the page, leaving Gidole's tidy sans-serif text to stay out of its way.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-golos-text: Golos Text is contemporary, its x-height filling the whole line. Neon, glowing and vibrant with its stamped-metal lowercase, feels like a bright tube set beside a quietly friendly sans.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-heebo: Glowing Neon draws its curves without a single thinning. What stands out is how Heebo, a sans-serif with a tall text band and curves that stop short, steadies Neon's unthinned glow.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-matangi: Vibrant Neon keeps one smooth line width across every letter. Neon is best at glowing in tall stamped-metal lowercase, while Matangi's twine-like sans-serif strokes are best at carrying a hefty, rounded text.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-michroma: Smooth as drawn wire, Neon holds one line width across every letter, while Michroma gives its plain sans letters a wide berth. Neon earns its keep where words are big and short.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Neon draws every letter at a single line width, glowing in stamped-metal lowercase. And Mochiy Pop One, a plain sans with a huge lowercase eye, reads best when Neon gets the big sizes.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Pure glow: Neon keeps its line width uniform and its stamped-metal lowercase tall and vivid. Mochiy Pop P One, a sans-serif with a sizable lowercase and wide gaps between letters, lets all that brightness land cleanly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text, a sans-serif with tall bodies that make its lowercase look bold, flares its terminals outward. And beside Neon's flat, unvarying line, whole paragraphs of it would read sturdy, the flared ends keeping things moving.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads clean, its large central band and unclosed curves giving the text line a steady, technical-pen feel. Give Neon a generous size so its glowing line has space.
